video.title: Good Morning, Sunshine! ☀️ Morning Routine Song for Kids | Meadowbop Kids Songs
video.description:
Rise and shine! ☀️ Wake up, stretch, brush your teeth and eat breakfast with Lily, Leo and Pip in this happy morning routine song for kids.

Good Morning, Sunshine! is an original morning routine song that turns getting ready into a fun sing-along. Follow the bouncing ball and sing every word with Lily, Leo, Pip the Duck, Rosie the Pig. Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6) learning daily routines and English words.

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:08 The sun is peeking through my window
0:25 Chorus: Good morning, good morning, hello to the day
0:42 Brush, brush, brush my teeth so bright
1:17 Pancakes, berries, milk for me

🎵 Lyrics
The sun is peeking through my window,
Time to wake up, sleepy head!
Stretch up high and wiggle your toes,
Hop, hop, hop right out of bed!

[Chorus]
Good morning, good morning, hello to the day!
Good morning, good morning, let's laugh and play!
With a yawn and a stretch and a great big smile,
Good morning, sunshine, stay a while!

Brush, brush, brush my teeth so bright,
Up and down and left and right,
Splash my face and comb my hair,
Bubbles, bubbles everywhere!

[Chorus]

Pancakes, berries, milk for me,
Yummy, yummy, one, two, three!
Say thank you and clean my plate,
A brand new day, I just can't wait!

[Chorus]

🌼 About Meadowbop
Meadowbop makes brand-new, original sing-along songs about a kid's everyday life: waking up, brushing teeth, eating breakfast, going to school, playing, bath time and bedtime. Every song is family friendly, easy to sing, and made to help little ones learn routines, words and good habits with music.

New songs every day. Original music and lyrics © Meadowbop. Animated with computer tools.
